PDF Chat - Multi-user Hybrid RAG platform									Live
Built a production-grade multi-user RAG system enabling users to upload documents and receive grounded, citation-backed responses via a React chat interface.
Designed hybrid retrieval pipeline combining BM25 + dense embeddings with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), BGE reranking, and neighbour chunk expansion to improve answer relevance and context retention.
Engineered scalable backend using FastAPI, Supabase, and ChromaDB with persistent user sessions, chat history, and observability via LangSmith (latency + LLM tracing).
Built an LLM fine-tuning pipeline using QLoRA on Llama 3.1 8B, producing multiple LoRA adapters for comparative evaluation.
Deployed inference system on Modal (A10G GPU) with FastAPI to serve multiple model variants for A/B testing.
Designed evaluation framework combining LLM-as-judge scoring, manual review, and live user preference tracking stored in Supabase.
Implemented guardrails and intent classification routing system to ensure safe, structured, domain-specific responses.

Built a football analytics platform for Europe's Top 7 leagues with daily data ingestion and predictions from an ML model based on ELO ratings, rolling team form, and normalised betting-market odds to predict match outcomes (Home / Draw / Away) for upcoming matches.
Achieved 65% back-tested accuracy across held-out seasons by integrating statistical modelling with automated data pipelines, model versioning, and scheduled refreshes.

Extended the same ELO framework to build WC2026 Control Centre, which ingests international results, rates every team with full-history, 10-year, and 5-year ELO models, and simulates the 48-team tournament with Monte Carlo to produce match and progression probabilities.
Designed and deployed a multi-tenant SaaS platform with secure isolation using Supabase Auth and PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS).
Built automated LLM-driven reporting system generating scheduled newsletters summarising user standings, probabilities, and leaderboard changes.

Built an end-to-end autoencoder anomaly detection model for financial fraud with leakage-safe training pipelines, handling extreme class imbalance (≤1% fraud rate) by learning normal transaction behaviour rather than labelled fraud patterns.
Improved recall by 25% over an XGBoost baseline and tuned decision thresholds to flag fraud at 95% confidence, capturing up to 99% of total fraud losses while keeping false investigations low.
Lead analytics and AI engineering function, owning end-to-end data pipelines, model deployment, reporting systems, and production servicing across the organisation.
Drive development of AI-powered training platform embedded within the Perform application, integrating LLM-based capabilities and automated reporting workflows.
Define engineering standards for pipeline design, guardrail implementation, model validation, and production deployment to ensure reliability, scalability, and governance.
Partner with product, operations, and commercial teams to translate business requirements into deployable data and AI solutions.
Architected company's data function from the ground up, using BI Platform, Azure SQL DB, Databricks, and Data Lake to support scalable analytics engineering across the organisation.

Designed and maintained company-wide ETL pipelines with integrated data quality checks and cleansing routines, achieving a 27% reduction in processing time and ensuring consistently reliable datasets for analysis.

Implemented an API-based data connectivity pipeline integrating Vald hardware with the Azure data platform, reducing manual data ingestion from 3 hours to under 10 minutes and establishing a reusable integration blueprint for future source connections.

Built and maintained interactive Power BI dashboards by consolidating 7 separate Excel-based reports into a single dynamic report with filters, KPIs, and segment-level breakdowns, increasing BI adoption across teams.
Built sports prediction and analytics systems using Poisson models and Monte Carlo simulation, achieving 65% prediction accuracy across a full season.
Conducted data-driven vendor analysis for transport investment decision-making, applying statistical modelling and A/B testing to shortlist optimal providers.
Designed and implemented an automated pipeline to process over 10 million customer records, integrating API data sources and significantly reducing manual processing time for the team.
Optimised SQL queries for a business-critical dashboard, cutting report refresh time by approximately half and contributing to a measurable increase in client usage over a five-month period.
Developed a predictive modelling tool on customer data to forecast tax projections, improving the tax planning process for the client.

Configured API integrations across the project and built a scheduler that extracted the previous day's tax return records and delivered formatted client reports at a scheduled time, reducing manual effort for the team.
